currentWork.title: FINAL.41 production complete; real-device navigation confirmation pending
currentWork.releaseStatus: FINAL.41 is merged, deployed, and live-verified. The next evidence is the operator's real iPhone confirmation of direction-aware off-route rerouting and turn-aware MAP follow zoom.
releaseScope: Initial route search and manual recalculation remain direction-agnostic.
Only sustained off-route automatic rerouting may add a reliable travel heading; unreliable direction evidence falls back to ordinary HGV rerouting without a bearing constraint.
The relay converts that optional heading into an ORS start-bearing sector with optimized=false while preserving driving-hgv and exact registered vehicle restrictions.

MAP current-position follow detects significant upcoming route bends from existing route geometry and changes at most one zoom level per GPS update toward 16/17/18/19 as the turn approaches, then relaxes afterward.
FINAL.40 highway/JCT behavior and FINAL.36 detour safety caps remain unchanged.

decision: Direction applies only to automatic off-route reroutes; initial and manual searches remain direction-agnostic.
Do not force a bearing when travel direction is not reliable enough.
Turn-aware zoom runs only while MAP current-position follow is ON and moves one level per GPS update.
Keep driving-hgv, exact vehicle restrictions, highway/JCT safety logic, upstream-call guards, and no-car/no-straight-line fallback unchanged.
Keep AN15 learned numeric promotion intentionally paused and do not restore OCR/Analysis.
nextActions: On the real iPhone, intentionally leave the route while moving and confirm automatic reroute prefers the current travel direction instead of a backward/opposite start.
With MAP current-position follow ON, approach a clear turn and confirm the map zooms in gradually and relaxes after the turn.
Report any exact failure as new field evidence before changing thresholds or bearing/zoom behavior again.
FINAL.40 fullscreen/highway retest can still be reported independently.
